[i] I had to sacrifice the players' gaming progress to make a new leaderboard, I apologize for the inconvenience. [/i]

2) Separate leaderboards for 3x3 and 5x5 modes.
3) Now the positions of players in the leaderboard are active links to their profiles. [/b]
